# Retained workflow documentation URL

The current supported application is the macOS Tauri/Rust product. Use the
[current workflow guide](WORKFLOWS_OVERVIEW.md),
[build guide](../../docs/BUILDING.md) and [testing guide](../../docs/testing.md).

The old automatic GPU selection, multi-platform installer and manual-only CI
instructions at this URL did not match the current manifests and automatic
`ci.yml` triggers. They have been replaced by links to the authoritative path.
A workflow file or uploaded ad-hoc bundle does not establish release readiness.
